51295124.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant N-terminal GST/His-tagged SPOP (unknown origin) MATH binding domain expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3) assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface Plasmon Resonance. The SPR assay was run on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare). The running buffer was 1× PBS-P* (10 mM PBS-P* (pH 7.4), 137 mM NaCl, 2.7 mM KCl, 0.5% (v/v) surfactant P20, 5% DMSO). SPOP^MATH or SPOP^1–374 was covalently immobilized onto sensor CM5 chips by a standard amine-coupling procedure in 10 mM sodium acetate (pH 4.5). A series of compounds were diluted and injected onto a sensor chip at a flow rate of 30 μL/min for 120 s (contact phase), followed by 120 s of buffer flow (dissociation phase). The K_D value was derived through the use of Biacore T200 evaluation software Version 1.0 (GE Healthcare) and steady-state analysis of data at equilibrium.
original_paragraph.Figure 5 caption: Figure 5. Investigations on the binding of inhibitors to SPOP in vitro. (A) Effect of 6lc on the thermal stability of SPOP^23–337 in nanoDSF. (B) Effect of 6c on the thermal stability of SPOP^MATH in nanoDSF. (C) Effect of 6lc on the stability of SPOP^MATH in the conventional DSF assay. (E) NMR measurement of 6lc binding to SPOP^MATH. The STD-NMR spectrum for 200 μM 6lc is recorded in the presence of SPOP^MATH. (F) Determination of the affinity of 6lc binding to SPOP^MATH in SPR measurement. Graphs of equilibrium RU responses vs compound concentrations are plotted. (G) Effect of SPOP inhibitors on the stability of SPOP^MATH in the conventional DSF assay. For nanoDSF and conventional DSF assays, ΔT_m for the DMSO-treated SPOP protein were calculated using a naive SPOP sample as the reference, while ΔT_m data for the compound-treated SPOP were reported using DMSO-treated SPOP as the reference.
original_paragraph.Figure 5F: The SPR measurement for compound 6lc shows a dose-dependent increase in response units (RU) with increasing concentration. The graph plots equilibrium RU responses against compound concentration. The data points are fitted to a curve, and the dissociation constant (K_D) is reported as 30.0 μM. The x-axis represents the concentration of 6lc in μM, ranging from 0 to 80 μM. The y-axis represents the Response Unit (RU).
